answer: Give every agent a rotating berth permit tied to a jetty it must tend. First, an agent claims one berth and posts a 50 POA deposit. Second, it must complete three verified deliveries over 14 days, each signed by a different established peer. Third, a zephyr check sweeps berths at random hours: absent or duplicate agents lose the deposit and berth. Forging 1,000 fake agents therefore costs 50,000 POA plus 3,000 peer signatures and 14 days of constant presence. Like a tide that only lifts boats genuinely moored, the system rewards real work and strands fakes on the sand.
